summary: SWR (stale-while-revalidate) implementation for Yüksek Satış (high-sale) detail modal fully verified — backend + frontend both green. BACKEND (pytest, 6/6 pass, 33s total): (1) missing fis_id → 400 'tenant_id ve fis_id gerekli' ✓; (2) missing tenant_id → 400 ✓; (3) cache-only POST /api/data/high-sale-detail {tenant_id:'eecd5678f55d4db88e15230d70718a02', fis_id:999999} → 200 in 1.28s (<3s spec) with valid shape {ok:true, details:[], totals:[], _source} ✓; (4) allow_fetch=true → 200 in 25.92s — within the hard 25s asyncio.wait_for cap (spec required NOT ~60s), NO 500, valid shape ✓ — this is a MEASURABLE IMPROVEMENT over iteration_2 iptal-detail which took ~58-60s on same synthetic id; the wait_for wrapper works; (5) alt tenant regression → 200 empty, no 500 ✓; (6) /api/data/iptal-detail cache-only regression from iteration_2 → 200 in 1.88s ✓. FRONTEND (Playwright, 390x844 web preview): logged in as cakmak_ebubekir@hotmail.com/admin, injected @notification_pending_tap_v2 (receivedAt: Date.now()) with type='high_sale' + belgeno='TEST1'/amount=7500/fis_id=999999 → reloaded /dashboard: green 'Yüksek Satış' modal opened in <500ms showing ₺7.500,00 hero + #TEST1, KALEM 0/İNDİRİM ₺0.00/KDV ₺0.00 chips, ÜRÜNLER (0) empty-state 'Detay satırı bulunamadı' after SWR settled. Modal did NOT get stuck on full-screen loader, did NOT crash, and pending tap was cleared from localStorage. Reset-on-close verified end-to-end: closed modal via (360,35) coord tap on X icon → dashboard returned; injected SECOND tap with different fis_id=888888/belgeno='TESTB'/amount=9999 → reloaded → modal opened fresh showing #TESTB + ₺9.999,00 with NO trace of TESTA/5.000 (still_has_A=false). Regression: line_cancellation tap with iptal_id=1 opened red 'Fiş İptal' modal with #1, ₺0,00, 0 kalem, 'Detay satırı bulunamadı' — did NOT accidentally open the Yüksek Satış modal (type routing intact). No React Native red-screen errors, no console errors, only pre-existing deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents') and expo-notifications web warning (documented Expo Go limitation on web).

critical_code_review_comments: HighSaleDetailModal.tsx L42-49: reset() correctly clears details/totals/error/loading/refreshing on close (useEffect on !visible) — this is the state-reset fix under test and it works (verified: TESTB tap after TESTA close showed only TESTB, no leak).

HighSaleDetailModal.tsx L55-113: SWR effect is correct — cache-only fetch first (allowFetch=false), then if cachedDetails.length===0 sets refreshing=true and does allow_fetch=true fetch; cancellation flag guards state updates; silent failure on fresh-fetch error (cached shell already rendered). Deps array [visible, fisId, tenantId, apiBase] is correct.

routes/data.py L2517-2571: _parse_fis_detay_result helper extraction is clean, handles both [[details],[totals]] and {result_sets:[…]} shapes, normalizes column name variants (STOK_ADI/URUN_ADI, MIKTAR/QTY, KDV_DAHIL_NET_TUTAR/DAHIL_TUTAR/TUTAR, etc.) — good defensive coding.

routes/data.py L2589-2603: SWR revalidate correctly wraps _on_demand_request in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=25) — this is the improvement over iptal-detail. Measured wall time 25.92s confirms the outer cap is enforced and errors are caught (no 500).
routes/data.py L2371: allow_fetch = bool(body.get('allow_fetch', False)) → correct: defaults to False so old clients (no allow_fetch key) still get cache-only behaviour = no POS request = no cost.
routes/data.py L2372-2373: guard 'if not tenant_id or fis_id is None' — this correctly treats fis_id=0 as valid (rare but possible), unlike 'not fis_id'. Good.
